7271.title: Claude permission denials preserve empty SDK reasons
7271.rootCauseOneLine: The automatic-denial callback uses nullish coalescing for an SDK reason, preserving empty strings instead of the policy explanation.
7271.proposedFix: Use the existing policy denial message whenever the optional SDK reason has no non-whitespace text; verify the actual hook-to-API failure before designing session recovery.
7271.caveats: Both clean runs verify only the SDK-facing denial producer, not actual hook execution, API rejection, persisted poisoning, or fork behavior. Five existing bridge tests fail identically on pristine main in this environment; no automatic fix PR.
